basic_info.description: In the heart of Noe Valley, this beautiful Victorian home, built in 1905, is on the market for the first time in 34 years. Recently updated with fresh paint inside and out, the home combines timeless architectural charm with spacious interiors and modern touches.  The main level features a sunlit, south-facing formal living room with a charming bay window. The open-concept kitchen, dining area, and den create a spacious and inviting living space, complete with French doors leading to a large deck that overlooks lush gardens and scenic views. A full bathroom and direct garden access complete this level.  Upstairs, a beautifully crafted staircase leads to three generously sized bedrooms and a second full bathroom, providing ample space for family living or guests.
